text:
mira: Heads up, seeing a large ArgoCD prune/coalesce wave at 07:12 UTC affecting eu-west GPU nodepools — a bunch of apps moved to Terminating and some GPU nodepools show 'orphaned' taints.

deploy-bot: ArgoCD prune wave started for app-of-apps-eu-west (coalesce=true, batch_size=150) at 2026-03-18T07:12:04Z. Controller leader: argocd-0.

jon: What exactly is failing? kubelet logs or helm hooks?

mira: Helm pre-delete hooks are hitting 409 conflicts when trying to remove CRs that another controller touches. Example error from argocd-controller logs:
```
E0308 07:13:12.123 1 helm.go:412] failed to delete resource "helmrelease.apps.example.com/my-release": error when deleting "...": Operation cannot be fulfilled on helmreleases.apps.example.com \"my-release\": the object has been modified; please apply your changes to the latest version and try again
```
Also seeing kube API 429s and a flapping leader: two controllers temporarily both think they're leader when poddisruption happened in us-east -> simultaneous prune attempts across regions.

seb: That lines up with coalesce=batches getting very big. We had `coalesce=true` and bumped batch_size recently for throughput. If two leaders overlap you get overlapping pruning windows.

lina: We're also observing nodepools scale in during the prune window — autoscaler removed GPU nodes (min=0 for some test pools). That causes pods to hang in Terminating as they can't reattach volumes.

jon: Can you paste the argocd-cm snippet?

mira: Current entries in argocd-cm:
```
resource.customizations: |
  apps/HelmRelease:
    coalesce: true
  argocd: |
    prune.batchSize: 150
    prune.jitter: 0
```
(we set prune.jitter=0 to make prune deterministic; that probably made simultaneous waves worse.)

seb: Ok, actionable list: reduce batch_size, add jitter, and lower concurrency across regions. Proposed quick patch: set `prune.batchSize: 25` and `prune.jitter: 5s`. Also limit concurrent prunes with `prune.concurrency=2`.

mira: Agree. Also need to avoid scale-in during the window. Two options: 1) Temporarily set nodepool autoscaler min>=2 via Terraform for affected pools; 2) Add short-term annotation to nodepools to disable scale-down via cloud provider API pre-prune.

lina: Option 2 is faster for incident mitigation (we can call cloud API), but option 1 (Terraform) is required for long-term. We should weigh cost — keeping GPUs idle increases spend. Rough estimate: +$120/day per prod pool if we lock min nodes.

jon: For immediate fix I'll patch argocd-cm. Command I'll run now:
```
kubectl -n argocd patch cm argocd-cm --type merge -p '{"data":{"prune.batchSize":"25","prune.jitter":"5s","prune.concurrency":"2"}}'
kubectl -n argocd rollout restart deployment/argocd-application-controller
```
I'll watch the controller logs for stabilization.

mira: I'll run a short script to annotate affected nodepools to disable scale-down for 20m until we confirm prunes finish. Script gist: 
```
for pool in gpu-east gpu-west; do
  gcloud compute instance-groups set-autoscaling $pool --no-scale-down --region eu-west1
done
sleep 1200
# revert after 20m
```

seb: After immediate mitigation we should open a Terraform PR to change the autoscaler module to expose a `scale_down_window` or a `maintenance_windows` flag so we can automate pre-prune lockouts. Also add a Canary for coalesce config changes so we don't blow up global prune waves.

lina: I'll create the infra PR template: add `autoscaler.min_count` param and docs to the deployment runbook (prune-safe windows).

mira: Postmortem items: - revert any aggressive batch_size increases we pushed last week - add argocd leader election alert (if leader restarts >1 within 10m) - automate pre-prune scale-in disable via orchestration job in CI.

jon: Patch applied, controller restarted. Seeing prune rate drop and fewer 409s already. Watching for stuck Terminating pods to clear.

deploy-bot: Prune wave completed for app-of-apps-eu-west at 2026-03-18T07:34:11Z. Summary: 412 resources pruned, 7 failures (mostly transient conflicts).

mira: Good signal. I'll file the Terraform PR and link runbook updates. Thanks for the quick patches. :thumbsup:

seb: I'll follow up with a proposed default for coalesce settings in our argocd helm chart so teams don't override dangerously.

lina: PR templates and runbook additions in progress — will ping here when up.

jon: Closing loop — if anything reappears I'll escalate to oncall.
